correlation.limitation: Historical co-movement; no guarantee of future diversification

deleveraging_scenario.method: Risk flags first, then lowest score; full exits, not optimized sizing

quantitativePortfolioReview.comparison_scope: Same frozen risk/trend/industry/holding-exit screening; only opportunity score and rank vary.

outcome_protocol.allocation: Equal 1/K starting notional per selected ticker; unfilled slots stay cash with zero return.
outcome_protocol.cost_method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes; per-stock reference notional 10000, entry/exit fees and slippage deducted.
outcome_protocol.entry: Next trading session open after the signal (T+1).
outcome_protocol.exit: Close five trading sessions after entry (T+6 signal-relative).
outcome_protocol.method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes h5 convention; distinct from earlier T+5 regression labels.
outcome_protocol.missing_outcome_policy: Selected stocks with missing or immature outcomes make the group INCOMPLETE; never replace them or treat them as cash.

baseline.purpose: Frozen production AI opportunity reference; never rewritten by this experiment.

breakout.extension: Distance above 2% decreases the distance component; extra volume above 1.2 adds no score.
breakout.interpolation: Continuous piecewise linear interpolation; clamp outside anchor endpoints.
breakout.prior_level_definition: Highest high in the 55 completed sessions BEFORE the signal bar (Stage 4 breakout_level).

cost_convention.missing_assumption_policy: NOT_PROVIDED with null costs; Stage 7 binds the frozen research risk/cost configuration.
cost_convention.return_method: Not computed in this module; mature future outcomes must be appended separately with source and execution identity.
cost_convention.scope: Frozen research assumptions only; scores do not deduct costs. Future outcome comparisons must use the same execution and cost method.

parameters.formula_origin: Fixed provisional absolute anchors; no regression fit or return optimization.
parameters.horizon_interpretation: Preregistered research comparison; not a trading exit or expected return.
parameters.missing_policy: Missing/invalid inputs yield null component/composite/rank with explicit field lists; never impute five.
parameters.numeric_validation: Finite real numbers or numeric strings; booleans invalid; prices positive; volume ratio nonnegative.

outcome_protocol.entry: Next trading session open after the signal (T+1).
outcome_protocol.exit: Close five trading sessions after entry (T+6 signal-relative).
outcome_protocol.method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes h5 convention; distinct from earlier T+5 regression labels.

parameters.ranking_scope: Complete frozen Review Universe; no chunk-local percentile or rank normalization.
tie_break: score descending at frozen six decimals

trend.derived_ratios: 100*(numerator/denominator-1); derive moving-average gaps from frozen prices.
trend.interpolation: Continuous linear interpolation and endpoint linear extrapolation, clipped to [0,10].

units.distance: percent relative to prior breakout level
units.volume_ratio: mean volume last 5 / mean volume last 20

parameters.chair_limit: Summary may contain redundant evidence; no claim of an arithmetic double-counting defect.
parameters.daily_work: Compute and validate public facts daily; model interpretation can review events or exceptions.

event_comparisons.breakout: Confirmation: 0<=distance<=2 and ratio>=1.2; extension: distance>2; near: -2<=distance<0; low anchor: distance<-10.
event_comparisons.entry: Observed breakout confirmation requires review; contrary candle/volume/extension or technical safety flags require further review; never buy approval.
event_comparisons.market: Supportive: return20>0 and breadth>=0.5; defensive: return20<0 and breadth<0.5; mixed otherwise.
event_comparisons.risk: Review stop<=0 or close<=stop or stopdistance<=0, ATR>=8 or stopdistance>=12; controlled ATR<=3 and 0<stopdistance<=6.
event_comparisons.trend: Supportive: close>SMA20>SMA50>SMA200 and RS20>0 and RS60>0; bearish: close<SMA50<SMA200 and RS20<0 and RS60<0.
event_comparisons.volume: Ratio>=1.5 plus return5>0 or <0; return5=0 is no confirmation event.

parameters.horizon_interpretation: Review targets, not a calibrated prediction of a future return.

input_validation.nonpositive_stop: Observed technical safety failure, not absent data.
input_validation.numeric: Finite numeric values or numeric strings; booleans are invalid; zero is not missing.

parameters.market_scope: One shared snapshot; repeated model market scores are contextual audit values only.

outcome_protocol.allocation: Equal 1/K starting notional per selected ticker; unfilled slots stay cash with zero return.
outcome_protocol.cost_method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes; per-stock reference notional 10000, entry/exit fees and slippage deducted.
outcome_protocol.entry: Next trading session open after the signal (T+1).
outcome_protocol.exit: Close five trading sessions after entry (T+6 signal-relative).
outcome_protocol.method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes h5 convention; distinct from earlier T+5 regression labels.
outcome_protocol.missing_outcome_policy: Selected stocks with missing or immature outcomes make the group INCOMPLETE; never replace them or treat them as cash.

baseline.purpose: Frozen production AI opportunity reference; never rewritten by this experiment.

breakout.extension: Distance above 2% decreases the distance component; extra volume above 1.2 adds no score.
breakout.interpolation: Continuous piecewise linear interpolation; clamp outside anchor endpoints.
breakout.prior_level_definition: Highest high in the 55 completed sessions BEFORE the signal bar (Stage 4 breakout_level).

cost_convention.missing_assumption_policy: NOT_PROVIDED with null costs; Stage 7 binds the frozen research risk/cost configuration.
cost_convention.return_method: Not computed in this module; mature future outcomes must be appended separately with source and execution identity.
cost_convention.scope: Frozen research assumptions only; scores do not deduct costs. Future outcome comparisons must use the same execution and cost method.

parameters.formula_origin: Fixed provisional absolute anchors; no regression fit or return optimization.
parameters.horizon_interpretation: Preregistered research comparison; not a trading exit or expected return.
parameters.missing_policy: Missing/invalid inputs yield null component/composite/rank with explicit field lists; never impute five.
parameters.numeric_validation: Finite real numbers or numeric strings; booleans invalid; prices positive; volume ratio nonnegative.

outcome_protocol.entry: Next trading session open after the signal (T+1).
outcome_protocol.exit: Close five trading sessions after entry (T+6 signal-relative).
outcome_protocol.method: Existing short_horizon_outcomes h5 convention; distinct from earlier T+5 regression labels.

parameters.ranking_scope: Complete frozen Review Universe; no chunk-local percentile or rank normalization.
tie_break: score descending at frozen six decimals

trend.derived_ratios: 100*(numerator/denominator-1); derive moving-average gaps from frozen prices.
trend.interpolation: Continuous linear interpolation and endpoint linear extrapolation, clipped to [0,10].

units.distance: percent relative to prior breakout level
units.volume_ratio: mean volume last 5 / mean volume last 20

parameters.chair_limit: Summary may contain redundant evidence; no claim of an arithmetic double-counting defect.
parameters.daily_work: Compute and validate public facts daily; model interpretation can review events or exceptions.

event_comparisons.breakout: Confirmation: 0<=distance<=2 and ratio>=1.2; extension: distance>2; near: -2<=distance<0; low anchor: distance<-10.
event_comparisons.entry: Observed breakout confirmation requires review; contrary candle/volume/extension or technical safety flags require further review; never buy approval.
event_comparisons.market: Supportive: return20>0 and breadth>=0.5; defensive: return20<0 and breadth<0.5; mixed otherwise.
event_comparisons.risk: Review stop<=0 or close<=stop or stopdistance<=0, ATR>=8 or stopdistance>=12; controlled ATR<=3 and 0<stopdistance<=6.
event_comparisons.trend: Supportive: close>SMA20>SMA50>SMA200 and RS20>0 and RS60>0; bearish: close<SMA50<SMA200 and RS20<0 and RS60<0.
event_comparisons.volume: Ratio>=1.5 plus return5>0 or <0; return5=0 is no confirmation event.

parameters.horizon_interpretation: Review targets, not a calibrated prediction of a future return.

input_validation.nonpositive_stop: Observed technical safety failure, not absent data.
input_validation.numeric: Finite numeric values or numeric strings; booleans are invalid; zero is not missing.

parameters.market_scope: One shared snapshot; repeated model market scores are contextual audit values only.
